title: OpenAI Launches Sponsored Agents for AI-Powered Advertising
summary: OpenAI unveils Sponsored Agents, new marketer tools, and HubSpot/Shopify integrations to transform AI-driven advertising experiences in 2026.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- OpenAI introduced Sponsored Agents, a new native advertising format that enables brands to deploy AI agents directly within ChatGPT conversations.
- New marketer tools and enterprise integrations with HubSpot and Shopify allow advertisers to create, manage, and optimize AI-powered campaigns at scale.
- The platform officially launched on September 16, 2026, marking OpenAI's first major move into the advertising technology sector.


OpenAI officially launched a suite of AI-powered advertising products on September 16, 2026, introducing Sponsored Agents as a native advertising format within ChatGPT. The move positions OpenAI as a direct competitor in the advertising technology sector, offering brands new ways to engage users through conversational AI experiences backed by enterprise-grade integrations with HubSpot and Shopify.


## What Are Sponsored Agents


Sponsored Agents represent a fundamentally new advertising format that allows brands to deploy custom AI agents directly within ChatGPT conversations. Unlike traditional display or search ads, these agents can engage users in natural dialogue, answer product questions, provide personalized recommendations, and facilitate transactions without breaking the conversational flow. Brands maintain full control over agent behavior, responses, and data handling through OpenAI's marketer dashboard.


The system uses retrieval-augmented generation to ensure agents deliver accurate, up-to-date product information while adhering to brand guidelines. Advertisers can configure agents to handle everything from customer service inquiries to product discovery and purchase assistance, creating seamless end-to-end experiences.


## Marketer Tools and Campaign Management


OpenAI launched a comprehensive marketer platform alongside Sponsored Agents, providing tools for campaign creation, performance analytics, and audience targeting. The platform enables advertisers to:


- Build and deploy custom agents without coding experience
- Monitor real-time engagement metrics including conversation depth, conversion rates, and user satisfaction scores
- A/B test different agent personalities, response strategies, and product recommendations
- Set budget controls and bidding strategies for agent placements


The dashboard integrates directly with existing[AI dashboard builder](https://emergent.sh/ai-dashboard-builder/advertising) workflows, allowing marketers to incorporate Sponsored Agents data into their broader analytics infrastructure.


## HubSpot and Shopify Integrations


Enterprise integrations form a core component of the launch. The HubSpot integration synchronizes customer data, conversation history, and lead information bidirectionally, ensuring Sponsored Agents have access to CRM context while feeding engagement data back into marketing automation workflows. Shopify integration enables direct product catalog access, real-time inventory checking, and native checkout capabilities within ChatGPT conversations.


Both integrations support custom workflows and webhooks, allowing technical teams to build sophisticated automation around Sponsored Agent interactions. Shopify merchants can launch agents that handle everything from product recommendations to post-purchase support, while HubSpot users can deploy agents for lead qualification, content delivery, and nurture campaigns.


## Availability and Pricing


Officially launched on September 16, 2026, Sponsored Agents are available to advertisers globally through OpenAI's self-service platform. The company introduced a pay-per-engagement pricing model where brands are charged based on meaningful conversation interactions rather than impressions or clicks. Minimum campaign budgets start at $5,000 monthly, with enterprise pricing available for large-scale deployments requiring custom SLA agreements.


Early access partners including several Fortune 500 retailers and direct-to-consumer brands have been testing the platform since July 2026, reporting average engagement rates 3-5x higher than traditional digital advertising formats according to OpenAI's published case studies.


## What This Means


OpenAI's entry into advertising technology signals a major shift in how brands may engage consumers through AI platforms. By creating native advertising formats that leverage conversational AI capabilities, the company is betting that users prefer helpful, interactive brand experiences over traditional ad units. The enterprise integrations with platforms like HubSpot and Shopify suggest OpenAI is building a comprehensive[AI SaaS builder](https://emergent.sh/ai-saas-builder/advertising) ecosystem designed for long-term adoption. As conversational AI becomes more central to daily workflows, Sponsored Agents may represent the first iteration of an entirely new advertising channel that prioritizes utility and user experience over attention capture.
